items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: No I wouldn’t say that. The way he played, that was great.

ctx.x: Yeah. And was there people like, let’s say Phil Woods. If Phil Woods came to that thing would you guys be saying he’s a little modern for this.
No I wouldn’t say that. The way he played, that was great.
And now, when I was listening to you talk with Julia and Dick Hyman, Julia was talking about the studio days and she said to Dick, “you never turned anything down.”
